note: synthetic scenarios; hand-written. Outcomes are per scope; every requested module not listed under expected.modules is Ready. Counted = counted for acceptance (Will refuse, Gap, Limited, Check); Information and inherited rows are not counted. Row fields: rule (short id), outcome, counted, optional detail, section, inherited (true) and inherited_from (the direct producers whose effective outcome is non-Ready, in module order; compare as a set). Assumptions the plan leaves open, applied consistently: (1) only Will refuse and Limited propagate; Gap and Check never do; (2) propagation is transitive through effective outcomes (a consumer inherits from each direct producer's effective outcome), one inherited row per consumer; (3) 'CP-1 chart strip' is its own scope and does not propagate; (4) one section-omitted row per omitted report section, from _layout observed offline at write time (omitted: credit_snapshot what-changed; earnings_update company-profile, portfolio-fit, what-changed; relative_value yield-against-maturity, what-changed; covenant_refinancing none; distressed_restructuring liquidity-runway, portfolio-fit, what-changed; portfolio_decision what-changed). Module lists are the launcher's ordered lists: PATHWAY_MODULES minus CP-MODEL and CP-8, ordered by deploy_vii.registry.plan. Clean scenarios declare legal documents executed (with an executed agreement) only where CP-4 is in the pathway, give peers (user_list) where CP-1C is, ratings where CP-2H is, an observed quote where CP-3 or CP-3D is, and a portfolio workbook with a portfolio file for portfolio_decision. Wording of Will refuse and Run-without is open (A-live); the Portfolio Decision workbook-false Gap row is not keyed because its scope (module or pathway) is open.
